metadata.task: 独立 LLM 路径复核 (independent LLM path re-review) of Augur IRIS Pass 3 CWE-918 formal alerts
notes: The SARIF contains exactly one formal CWE-918 result for ruleId py/augur/sydent/pass3-ssrf; the invocation's toolExecutionNotifications are file-coverage/platform telemetry only (no diagnostic alerts), so no diagnostics or native-baseline results are mixed into this count.
CodeQL 分析成功，且本轮命中 1 条正式 SSRF 污点路径（无需声明无命中）。

No PyVul ground truth, fix commits, or CVE advisories were consulted for the triage itself; the ground-truth comparison in section 'post_review_vulnerability_match' uses only the commit data supplied by the user AFTER the independent review was complete.
Original SARIF, labels.json, and formal queries were not modified.

alert_location.description: URL construction BinaryExpr 'matrix://%s/...' % (matrix_server, quote(access_token)) passed as arg 0 of FederationHttpClient.get_json

source.mount_evidence: httpserver.py:119 account.putChild(b'register', self.sydent.servlets.registerServlet); instantiated at sydent.py:307
source.reachability: ClientApiHttpServer binds clientapi.http.bind_address '::' port 8090 by default (sydent.py:115-116, httpserver.py:135-140) - publicly reachable network interface
source.authentication: None. render_POST calls send_cors + get_args directly; there is no authV2 call in registerservlet.py (unlike accountservlet.py:38). The endpoint is unauthenticated.
source_locations: sydent/http/servlets/__init__.py:79 request_args = json.loads(request.content.read().decode('UTF-8')) - raw attacker POST body
sydent/http/servlets/__init__.py:87 request_args_bytes = copy.copy(request.args) - attacker query/form fallback

network_io_evidence: sydent/http/httpclient.py:52-55 response = yield self.agent.request(b'GET', uri.encode('utf8')) - real HTTP egress
sydent/http/matrixfederationagent.py:141-176 MatrixFederationAgent.request -> _route_matrix_uri -> Agent.usingEndpointFactory -> agent.request(method, uri, ...) - the request IS executed

sydent/http/matrixfederationagent.py:168-170 / :366 LoggingHostnameEndpoint(reactor, res.target_host, res.target_port) -> HostnameEndpoint(reactor, host, port) - concrete TCP dial to attacker-chosen host/port
sydent/http/matrixfederationagent.py:318-322 secondary egress triggered by the same attacker-chosen host: b'https://%s/.well-known/matrix/server' fetched via RedirectAgent

taint_path: -> is_valid_hostname(matrix_server) form check at :52 (passes; NOT a barrier)

attacker_control.port: optional explicit port accepted (is_valid_hostname allows host:port with port 1-65535; _route_matrix_uri honors explicit ports at matrixfederationagent.py:212-219; default federation port 8448)
attacker_control.scheme: fixed 'matrix://' (routed as TLS federation traffic by MatrixFederationAgent); the .well-known secondary fetch is fixed 'https://'
attacker_control.query: args['access_token'] is URL-encoded (urllib.parse.quote) into the query string - encoded, cannot break out of the query component
attacker_control.exploitability: 攻击者可完全控制出站请求的目的 host（含 127.0.0.1、localhost、10.x/192.168.x/172.16.x 等私网 IPv4 字面量，数字标签可通过 hostname_regex）及可选端口（1-65535），scheme 与 path 固定。可用于内部端口枚举与内网 HTTP 资源探测；响应体不直接回显给攻击者（'sub' 需为合法 MXID 且 server 部分必须等于 matrix_server），数据外传受限 - 与『可诱导向内部系统发送请求、无法控制请求头/外传数据、可用于端口枚举』的影响类别一致。

url_processing.detail: No urljoin / base-URL / relative-URL handling. The attacker-controlled host is directly %-interpolated into the full URL string; the destination host (and optional port) is wholly replaced by the attacker value. No parsing step re-derives or constrains the target.

protections_audit.is_valid_hostname (sydent/util/stringuti: Form validation only: hostname_regex (alnum/hyphen labels, digits allowed so IPv4 literals pass) + optional port range 1-65536. It ACCEPTS IP literals, 'localhost', RFC1918/private ranges and explicit ports. It is NOT a scheme check, allow-list, or IP restriction.
protections_audit.scheme_validation: none beyond the fixed 'matrix://' literal in the format string
protections_audit.private_ip_or_localhost_blocking: none anywhere on the path (matrixfederationagent.py:194-199 explicitly checks for IP literals only to route them directly, not to block them)
protections_audit.redirect_revalidation: none - RedirectAgent (matrixfederationagent.py:105-107) follows 3xx on the .well-known path without target re-validation
protections_audit.network_isolation: none in code (firewall is the documented operator workaround)
protections_audit.authentication_gating: endpoint is unauthenticated; even authenticated callers would retain host control (auth != SSRF sanitizer)
protections_audit.conclusion: No effective CWE-918 defense exists on this path in the analyzed snapshot.

results.fixed_destination_check: Not a trusted/fixed/admin-configured URL: the destination host is chosen per-request by the unauthenticated caller's matrix_server_name parameter. (Admin-configured destinations elsewhere - SMTP smtphost, OpenMarket API_BASE_URL, replication base_replication_url/peers, sentry DSN - were correctly excluded from this alert set.)
results.static_reachability_check: Real and full: twisted putChild route registration (httpserver.py:113/118/119) is invisible to dataflow but the servlet is instantiated (sydent.py:307), the handler reads the request body itself (servlets/__init__.py:79), the client API listens on '::':8090 (sydent.py:115-116, httpserver.py:135-140), and render_POST performs no authentication. The internal-function-only concern does not apply: this is an end-to-end public-entry chain, not a local path judgment on an internal function.
results.contamination_check: Clean: no file: local read, no URL-parsing-only sink, no test code (registerservlet.py is production code), no diagnostics query results in this alert. The single SARIF result is the formal path-problem alert.

codeflow_audit.threadflow_1: request.content.read() (servlets/__init__.py:79) -> request_args -> get_args return -> args -> matrix_server -> BinaryExpr: matches the real source->sink propagation.
codeflow_audit.threadflow_2: get_args() -> args -> matrix_server -> BinaryExpr: consistent shorthand of the same chain.
codeflow_audit.threadflow_3: args['matrix_server_name'] subscript (registerservlet.py:50) -> matrix_server -> BinaryExpr: the load-bearing host-control edge, confirmed at source.
codeflow_audit.threadflow_4: args['access_token'] (registerservlet.py:63) -> urllib.parse.quote -> BinaryExpr: real flow but only into the query component (encoded); corroborates the alert while the host edge is the decisive one.

checklist_answers.1_source_is_attacker_influenced: 是 - 未认证公共端点 POST body 的 matrix_server_name 字段（servlets/__init__.py:79 + registerservlet.py:50），入口真实可达。
checklist_answers.2_real_data_propagation_to_network_url: 是 - %-格式化直接将 matrix_server 插入 matrix:// URL 的 host 位置（registerservlet.py:60-64）并传给 get_json。
checklist_answers.3_urljoin_base_url_processing: 否 - 无 urljoin/base URL/相对 URL 处理；攻击者值直接整体替换目的主机（及可选端口）。
checklist_answers.4_sink_is_real_network_request: 是 - get_json -> twisted Agent.request(b'GET', uri) -> HostnameEndpoint TCP 拨号（httpclient.py:52, matrixfederationagent.py:176/:366），真实 HTTP(S) 出站；非仅构造 Request 对象或解析 URL。
checklist_answers.5_attacker_control_scope: host + 可选 port 完全可控；scheme/path 固定；query 仅携带编码后的 access_token。可用于内网探测与端口枚举，数据外传受限。
checklist_answers.6_effective_protections: 无 - is_valid_hostname 仅校验形式（放行 IPv4 字面量、localhost、私网段、显式端口）；无白名单、无私网 IP 拦截、无重定向重校验、无网络隔离。
checklist_answers.7_fixed_trusted_url: 否 - 目的地由未认证调用者逐请求指定，非管理员配置地址。
checklist_answers.8_static_path_really_reachable: 是 - 完整端到端公共入口链（路由挂载 httpserver.py:119、默认 '::':8090 监听、render_POST 无鉴权），非仅内部函数局部路径。
checklist_answers.9_contamination_by_file_or_diag_or_test: 否 - 该告警为唯一正式结果，无诊断查询/测试代码/file: 读取混入。

results.final_reasoning: The single formal alert is a genuine, end-to-end, unauthenticated SSRF path: attacker POSTs matrix_server_name to /_matrix/identity/v2/account/register, the value (form-checked only by is_valid_hostname, which accepts private IPv4 literals, localhost and explicit ports) becomes the host of a matrix:// URL that FederationHttpClient.get_json actually fetches via twisted Agent/HostnameEndpoint TCP dial, with default port 8448 or an attacker-specified port, and additionally triggers an https:// .well-known fetch to the same attacker-chosen host. No sanitizer, allow-list, or private-address blocking exists. Verdict: likely_tp, confidence 0.95.

post_review_vulnerability_match.task: 在独立复核完成后，判断本轮分析是否命中用户提供的该项目真实漏洞（commit 0f00412017f25619bc36c264b29ea96808bf310a, CWE-918 SSRF）

matched_chain.alert: The single formal alert (registerservlet.py:60-64 -> get_json('matrix://%s/_matrix/federation/v1/openid/userinfo?...')) is exactly the vulnerable call in the code_before of render_POST: same file, same get_json call, same 'matrix://%s' % matrix_server construction, same args['matrix_server_name'] parameter, same is_valid_hostname weak validation (code_before state matches the analyzed snapshot line-for-line).
matched_chain.vuln_condition_present: The analyzed snapshot contains the pre-fix state: is_valid_hostname (with optional-port branch, digits-only labels that admit IPv4 literals) gates the host, no IP blacklisting, no allow-list - precisely the 'lack of parameter validation or IP address blacklisting' root cause stated in the advisory. Commit 0f00412 (together with 9e57334/8936925/3d531ed) replaces it with is_valid_matrix_server_name in all three call sites.

coverage_of_other_functions.authenticate_request / _notify: Labeled and documented as real attacker-reachable chains in labels.json / query_generation_notes.md (verifier X-Matrix origin key-fetch chain; bind.py _notify onbind POST chain), but they produced NO formal pass3.sarif alerts: the bind chain is a documented taint break at the external signedjson.sign_json boundary, and the verifier chain did not fire an alert in this run. Only the register chain fired.
coverage_of_other_functions.is_valid_hostname: The weak validator itself is the common root cause; it appears in the alert path as a non-barrier check (registerservlet.py:52), so the alert's taint path passes through the exact code fixed by this commit.

post_review_vulnerability_match.impact_match: Advisory impact ('Sydent can be induced to send HTTP GET requests to internal systems ... possible to perform an internal port enumeration') matches the assessed exploitability of the alert exactly: attacker-chosen host + optional port, GET method, fixed scheme/path, limited exfiltration.
post_review_vulnerability_match.conclusion: 命中。本轮唯一正式告警落在修复提交所修改的 render_POST 函数的精确漏洞调用点上（register/matrix_server_name -> matrix:// federation GET 链），且弱校验 is_valid_hostname 正是 0f00412 系列补丁修复的根因。命中方式为 1-of-3 个真实漏洞链（render_POST 命中；_notify 与 authenticate_request 链虽在标签/笔记中确认，但未产出正式告警）——按漏洞（CWE-918 单一漏洞条目）粒度判定为命中。
